sources.title: Sensory modality-specific wiring of thalamocortical circuits
sources.coverage: TCA guidance mechanisms (DTB/corridor cells/PSPB/handshake), subplate waiting compartment, Ephrin-A5/EphA4 topographic gradients, thalamic waves (E14+), superior colliculus as sensory gatekeeper, cross-modal plasticity, intrinsic vs activity-dependent specification, FO vs HO nuclei identity
sources.notes: Definitive 2025 review from López-Bendito lab, comprehensive and well-cited

sources.title: Development and Evolution of Thalamocortical Connectivity
sources.journal: Cold Spring Harbor Perspectives in Biology
sources.coverage: Handshake hypothesis with Arid1a Emx1-Cre/hGFAP-Cre genetic evidence, subplate neuron origins, TCA topographic targeting (FGF8 repositioning), PSPB crossing mechanisms, evolutionary context
sources.notes: Molnár lab (Oxford) comprehensive review with strong genetic evidence for handshake hypothesis

sources.title: Direct and Indirect Downstream Pathways That Regulate Repulsive Guidance Effects of FGF3 on Developing Thalamocortical Axons
sources.coverage: FGF3 dual mechanism: direct PC-PLC pathway + indirect PI3K→Slit1 pathway; chick embryo in vitro turning assay + in vivo bead implantation
sources.notes: First demonstration of dual-pathway FGF3 guidance in TCAs; chick model, translation to mice pending

sources.title: How the Barrel Cortex Became a Working Model for Developmental Plasticity: A Historical Perspective
sources.coverage: Barrel cortex 50-year history, whisker-barrelette-barreloid-barrel four-station relay, critical period mechanisms

sources.title: The enigmatic fetal subplate compartment forms an early tangential cortical nexus and provides the framework for construction of cortical connectivity
sources.coverage: Subplate trilaminar organization (ingrowth zone / navigation zone / waiting compartment), role in TCA timing and target selection, clinical relevance

sources.title: Development of the Thalamocortical Interactions: Past, Present and Future
sources.coverage: Overview of TCA development fields including axon guidance, thalamic influence on cortical specification, spontaneous thalamic activity
